name: Minecraft: Security Breach
tagline: Survive, craft, and fight through the Pizzaplex in blocky Minecraft style!
description: Brings full Minecraft survival mechanics directly into FNAF: Security Breach! Gather materials from environmental objects, craft swords, bows, and barricades, manage hunger, and team up or face off in 2–4 player Co-op and Versus modes inside the Mega Pizzaplex.
